measure.sourceTitle: Buy Tickets for One World Observatory in New York City
measure.evidenceText: The official One World Observatory result is exact New York City and shows General Admission Starting at $44, with an additional $3.50 processing fee plus tax. The amount is a from/starting price and the adult basis is not explicitly stated. Other results were bundles/ranges (CityPASS), nearby Goshen (LEGOLAND New York), or had no numeric adult price.
measure.referencePeriod: Result crawled 4 days before 2026-08-01; no qualifying non-from adult row
measure.searchQuery: New York City United States official attraction adult admission ticket price taxes included
measure.reason: Not found under the strict contract: the strongest exact-city official ticket is a starting-from amount and lacks an explicit adult basis; the processing fee is stated but tax-inclusive/exclusive treatment of the ticket price is not. Bundled/range and nearby-city results were rejected.
